verdict.rationale: Insomnia lets users keep data entirely local (Scratch Pad, Local Vault) or sync via their own Git repo instead of the cloud, and states its servers cannot read synced project data, giving users indirect control over where/how long data persists. However there is no explicit documentation of data retention policies, account/data deletion mechanisms, or GDPR-style controls, and a community report notes a shift toward requiring accounts, which cuts against a strong privacy-control narrative. Missing for 10: explicit account/data deletion feature, documented retention period, and independent confirmation that local-only workflows fully avoid any server-side retention.
